name: Rebuild a whole page as code (Tailwind, React, HTML or Vue) with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Rebuild a whole page as code (Tailwind, React, HTML or Vue) with MiroMiro

### How it works
Rebuild every section of a web page as code: Tailwind, React (JSX), HTML + CSS or Vue. **Extract Hero and Find Sections** loads the page from **Set Website and Output** in a real browser, rebuilds the hero and lists every other section. Each one is rebuilt by **Extract Each Section as Code** with its real colors, fonts, spacing, breakpoints and hover styles. You get one file per section in a zip, and **Get Whole-Page Preview Link** returns a link to the whole page assembled, with a Download HTML button. A section that fails is skipped and counted in `failed`. Failed calls are not charged.

### Setup
This template uses the verified community node **n8n-nodes-miromiro** (tested with version 0.1.4 on n8n 1.123).
1. On n8n Cloud, search "MiroMiro" in the nodes panel (an admin may need to turn on Verified Community Nodes). Self-hosted: Settings > Community nodes > Install `n8n-nodes-miromiro`, see https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/
2. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
3. Open **Extract Hero and Find Sections** > Credential > Create new, and paste the key.
4. Select the same credential in **Extract Each Section as Code**.
5. Set your page and `output` in **Set Website and Output** and click **Execute workflow**.
6. Download the zip from **Zip the Code Files**; open `pagePreviewUrl` from **Get Whole-Page Preview Link**.

Each section costs 10 credits, so a page of 6 to 12 sections is 60 to 120. The same page again within 24 hours is free.

### Customization
Change `.slice(0, 15)` in **List Remaining Sections** to rebuild fewer sections. Commit the files to GitHub or send the zip to Google Drive. Menus, sliders and forms come back as static markup in their first visible state.

![The workflow, in case the preview does not load](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoraiaBarroso/n8n-nodes-miromiro/main/docs/templates/rebuild-whole-page-as-code.png)

nodes.name: Save Each Section as a File

parameters.content:
## Choose the page

Put the page and the output (`tailwind`, `jsx`, `html` or `vue`) in **Set Website and Output**.

## Find the sections

The first call rebuilds the hero and lists every other section on the page, in order.

## Rebuild, zip and link

Each section becomes code, one file each in a zip. A failed section is skipped and counted. The last node gives the whole-page link.
